invalid_samples.reason: Pool tool picked the upstream Lua binding key l-item.cc:1779 as usage; the reviewer-visible context was not the display site (theirs displays it in item-name.cc:396; our display consumer was not located). Excluded from tallies; reported by lane1.

confirmed.summary: Ally-order menu misalignment: first line prefix width 14 (对盟友的命令：) but continuation lines have 0 leading columns.
confirmed.evidence: Both sides print three catalogue lines verbatim (ours shout.cc:504-506, theirs shout.cc:572-574). Display width before the first command letter: theirs 10/10/10, ours 14/0/0.
confirmed.lanes: lane1 and lane2 both flagged ours

confirmed.summary: '你发光更亮了' is an unidiomatic collocation for 'You glow brighter.'
MONS_PLAYER_GHOST suffix 'ghost' → 幽灵, while full name 'player ghost' → 玩家鬼魂 and kill modifier 'spectre' → 幽灵.
'ghost' → 鬼魂 but 'player ghost' → 玩家幽灵, and 幽灵 is also 'spectre'.
confirmed.evidence: Moderator lookup in frozen ui.po (display.monster entries).

confirmed.summary: 'Those who invite Qazlal's gaze' rendered 请求卡兹拉尔注视 (asking for) instead of attracting/courting; repeated 风暴 wording.
'unfathomably massive' rendered 令人难以理解地巨大 (incomprehensibly) rather than immeasurably.
Blinkbolt description says caster becomes 闪电箭, which is our name for the Lightning Bolt spell; 'the bolt's destination' reduced to 目的地.
'It seizes upon the passage of other souls' rendered 它夺取他人灵魂的旅程.
'%s is now too close for your liking.' rendered %s离你太近了。 dropping 'now' and the subjective nuance (minor).

advisory.summary: 吸取活物最大生命值的一小部分 can be read as max-HP reduction; mechanic is damage = max HP / 10 (cloud.cc:1213). Ambiguity, not a confirmed error.
'frangible' not rendered by either side; ours limits the target to 生物, which matches the actor-only mechanic, so not counted as an error.
同族史莱姆 adds a kinship sense to 'fellow slime' (allied slime). Dropping the leading space before full-width parentheses is not an error.
'You have hooves in place of feet.' is a state description; 你的脚变成了蹄子 reads as an event. Lane1 preferred theirs; lane2 tie.

rejected.summary: Lane2 flagged missing 19 leading spaces; the spaces exist to align with the English first line. Theirs aligns all three lines at width 10, which is correct.

pending_validation_gap.summary: Possessive DESC_ITS argument fill differs by implementation; needs runtime output.

confirmed_counts.definition: affected_samples = distinct sample_id; confirmed_findings = records in confirmed; defect_points = sum of defect_points (C7 counts terminology collision and omission separately). Compare sides only on the same unit; sample-bound, not catalogue-wide.
